execution.single_leg_entry: exact instrument M1 open with open_time == signal_time
execution.pairs_entry: exact common CNY+Si M1 open with open_time == signal_time
execution.simultaneous_signal_policy: collapse exact semantic duplicates; if >1 distinct signal remains for same candidate/instrument/signal_time, skip all as AMBIGUOUS_SIMULTANEOUS_SIGNAL
execution.stop_gap: fill raw open when open gaps adversely through frozen stop
execution.target_gap: fill frozen target; no positive gap slippage
execution.r_target_basis: actual next-open risk to frozen signal stop
execution.invalid_risk_or_target: explicit skip diagnostic; never silent continue
execution.scenario_identity: GROSS/BASE/STRESS are three scenario rows of one raw trade path
execution.friction_invariant: GROSS pnl_bps >= BASE pnl_bps >= STRESS pnl_bps
execution.signal_conservation: generated distinct signals = executed raw trade paths + explicit signal skips
execution.same_timestamp_exit_entry_precedence: a position exit timestamp is processed before a new exact-open entry at the same timestamp; equality does not violate exclusivity

data_policy.availability_window: materialize M1 only when open_time >= requested start AND close_time < requested end; close exactly at end is excluded
data_policy.m1_grid: timezone-aware unique monotonically increasing opens exactly on whole-minute grid; close_time=open_time+1 minute
data_policy.raw_ohlc: finite positive and exact instrument-tick-valid before strategy comparisons
data_policy.multi_file_overlap: equivalent duplicate timestamps collapse deterministically; conflicting OHLCV duplicate hard-fails
data_policy.protected_future_access: timestamp scan and raw file hash bytes may occur without numeric OHLCV materialization; access ledger distinguishes events

STRUCTURAL.m5_composition: exact expected five M1 timestamps in each Moscow clock 5-minute bin

pivot.scope: continuous across trading dates over valid M5 observations
pivot.activation: first M5 observation with OPEN_TIME >= known_time

level_family.lifetime_origin: first pivot causal activation trading date
level_family.snapshot_update: new qualifying touch creates immutable Vn+1
level_family.snapshot_transition: pending from Vn is cancelled; armed/disarmed state is inherited; no free re-arm
level_family.round_number: confluence only; within 1 instrument tick of round grid

mirror.role_flip: invalidate pending and disarm new/old side until ordinary re-arm

episodes.rearm: support close_ticks > level_ticks + tolerance; resistance close_ticks < level_ticks - tolerance; re-arm bar cannot itself trigger

GERCHIK_A_M5_PROXY.BPU2: next valid M5 observation in same snapshot version
GERCHIK_A_M5_PROXY.luft: max(1 tick, ROUND_HALF_UP(0.2 * signal-close risk ticks))

ORB.opening_range_composition: exact expected M1 opens from 10:00 through length-1; missing expected minute invalidates day/candidate
ORB.episode: first breakout of trading date only

TREND_PULLBACK.resumption: current trend regime must equal pullback direction
TREND_PULLBACK.expired_rearm_long: current regime LONG and low > EMA20; next later fresh touch may start
TREND_PULLBACK.expired_rearm_short: current regime SHORT and high < EMA20; next later fresh touch may start

executable_formulas.long_resume: regime=LONG AND close > ema20 AND close > close[t-1]
executable_formulas.short_resume: regime=SHORT AND close < ema20 AND close < close[t-1]

PAIRS.entry_transition: INSIDE -> OUTSIDE only; UNKNOWN -> OUTSIDE produces no entry
PAIRS.nan: does not re-arm and does not trigger convergence
PAIRS.distance: Gatev-style normalized price distance using past-only [t-window,t) moments
PAIRS.ols: alpha/beta estimated strictly from [t-window,t); current/future excluded
PAIRS.convergence: current causal rolling z reaches/crosses zero; execute next exact common OPEN
PAIRS.time_priority: TIME wins when 120th held bar is simultaneously day end or convergence close
PAIRS.day_end: closes position but does not re-arm threshold state
PAIRS.bars_held: open-exit counts completed held bars; close-exit counts held bars including exit bar

executable_formulas.distance_base: c0=c[t-window], s0=s[t-window]; spread[t]=c[t]/c0-s[t]/s0; historical moments use [t-window,t)
executable_formulas.z_entry: abs(z) >= z_entry only on INSIDE -> OUTSIDE transition

BOLLINGER_RSI.rsi: gain/loss ewm(alpha=1/14, adjust=False, min_periods=14); both avg_gain and avg_loss zero => NaN
BOLLINGER_RSI.continuous_outside_excursion: after expiry wait for return inside band before a new outside event
BOLLINGER_RSI.REENTRY_2R: 2R from actual next-open risk to frozen stop
BOLLINGER_RSI.REENTRY_FIXED_MID: BB20 midpoint frozen on signal bar

candidate_registry.identity: SHA256 of family + submodel + active parameters + family semantic fingerprint; single-leg instrument excluded
candidate_registry.complexity: count of active independent preregistered grid axes for the row; never human-assigned after results

selection_policy.single_leg_research_metric: POOLED union of normalized pnl_bps trades from CNY and Si
selection_policy.instrument_metrics: diagnostic only; no post-hoc extra eligibility gate
selection_policy.stress: ranking factor only in DEV; not an eligibility gate
selection_policy.parameter_plateau: robustness report only; never manual reselection

metrics.drawdown: realized_closed_trade_dd_bps; chronological by exit_time then trade_id; not portfolio mark-to-market DD

validation_status_policy.REJECTED: combined BASE expectancy_bps <= 0 OR combined BASE PF <= 1

validation_workflow.classification: preregistered frozen forward validation nested inside repository 2026 DISCOVERY period; not repository INTERNAL_CONFIRMATION and not pristine dataset-wide OOS
validation_workflow.causal_warmup: January history; no indicator reset at Mar1 or May1
validation_workflow.A_plus_B: metrics recomputed from actual union, never arithmetic average
validation_workflow.pre_read_gate: verify engine/spec/code/data hashes and reproduce frozen DEV selected ledgers before Validation OHLCV materialization
validation_workflow.post_access_change: any material strategy change after A/B outcomes were accessed creates new candidate identity and reused A/B is no longer clean frozen validation for that new candidate

freeze_policy.artifact_commit_F: optional child commit containing generated DEV/freeze artifacts
freeze_policy.q2_prevalidation_access: raw FILE SHA bytes may be read; numeric OHLCV must not be parsed/materialized
freeze_policy.access_ledger: actual file-hash / timestamp-scan / OHLCV-materialization provenance; hard-coded booleans are not evidence
freeze_policy.legacy_v3_scope: src/market_pattern_discovery/backtest/top5.py and results/top5_real_strategies_v1..v3 are historical versioned artifacts only; V4 runner imports only backtest.top5_v4 and V4 semantics come only from this contract

testing_policy.contract_tests: executable semantics, not JSON text PASS
testing_policy.future_mutation: signals <= T unchanged when future > T changes; completed trades with exit_time <= T unchanged
testing_policy.cache_rule: share signal cache only where signal definition identical; rerun execution for stop/target variants; friction may reuse raw path

research_protocol_compatibility.costs_slippage: GROSS/BASE/STRESS adverse-tick friction; commission explicitly NOT_INCLUDED

deviations: no exact discretionary source level process
source session/time filters not exactly reproduced

source_fidelity.structural_adaptations: daily-key-level/time-window/discretionary source filters are not fully reproduced
